messages:
Maya: hey folks, Maya here — starting today on infra. quick blocker: when I open Console (staging) I get 'access denied: no roles attached'. I need access to staging console + feature-flag admin to run a few canary tests. who should I ping? okta id is maya@redwood.ai :wave:
Samir: welcome! I can open a short-lived staging admin for you. we require a manager approval and an onboarding note. i'll kick off a ticket. do you need prod access now or just staging?
Maya: staging only for now. won't touch prod until i'm signed off.
Olivia: hey Maya 44b. staging FF admin is fine. prod FF requires the "flag-ops" training + a signed runbook ack. fill this form so security gets the approval: https://intra.redwood/requests/ff-entitlement. for staging i can add you immediately once Samir files the Jira. include 'audit:onboard/maya_v1' as the audit tag.
Jordan: FYI when you test flags, use the sandbox service or the QA cluster first. command to read a flag state from staging API (replace ENV_TOKEN):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ENV_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://staging.console.redwood/api/v1/flags?name=fastpath" | jq .
```
and if you're toggling, add a rollout note and link a PR. no prod flips between 08:00-10:00 PST without oncall signoff.
Samir: created INFRA-3509 to provision staging-admin for maya@redwood.ai (duration: 14 days). justification: onboarding + KV/caching canary tests. tagged @Olivia for entitlement grant.
devops-bot: INFRA-3509 created by Samir at 1780246832. Approvals pending.
okta-bot: OKTA-9011 created for maya@redwood.ai entitlement request. awaiting security review.
Olivia: approved staging featureflag-admin. assigned audit tag onboard/maya_v1. prod is withheld until training form is done.
devops-bot: role staged: staging-admin for maya@redwood.ai (provisioned at 1780246865). timeout set to 14d.
Maya: confirmed I can access staging console and see the Flags tab. tested the curl command, saw flag state. thanks! i will follow sandbox -> QA -> staging flow and not toggle prod. i added audit note 'onboard/maya_v1' to my actions.
Samir: great, welcome aboard Maya 389. reach out in this thread if anything else blocks you.
Olivia: ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of flag playbooks later today.
